estimates.why: Conservative prices for work no complete run has measured yet. Per-case minutes are the slowest measured unit of each kind, so a new case is never priced below what one already costs: backend 2.6 test-minutes, the slowest of 68 configured specs in run 41233844505 (p90 1.47); graphics 4.1, the whole catalog's spec time in catalog-gates run 33896869659 (243 s); a new job 6.0, the Build job of run 41233844505, the longest fixed-overhead job. Runs per landing: backend 1 full push run + 2.84 PR run-equivalents x 0.40 that select the whole set (ci06); graphics 2.84 PR + 1 merge-group runs x 0.68 of landings that raise the catalog gate (ci04: 38 of 56); a new job by its triggers: 2.84 PR run-equivalents (ci01: 3.88 PR runs per landing, a cancelled one at half), 1 merge-group, 1 push. Stack setup 2.3 minutes per configured stack, one stack per ten test-minutes (ci06). Scheduled runs a new case joins each day: backend 1 (configured-suite.yml, 10 1 * * *) + 2/7 (hosted-latency.yml, Sundays and Wednesdays); graphics 2 (catalog-gates.yml, 50 11 * * *, and nightly.yml's catalog calibration tripwire, 20 0 * * *). A new job is priced at the slowest measured job of its own tier (offline 15.5, E2E 10/15 (full) in push run 41258008804; backend 12.7, a configured shard; graphics 11.2, the catalog gate, run 41204535069; overhead 6.0, Build), times its static matrix size; a matrix built at run time counts as 15 entries, the widest in the repository (the offline shard cap). Offline: an added spec runs in every CI run of a landing (everyRun) and once a day in the nightly full run (nightly.yml, one cron a day).

revisions.rationale: Alarm and incident ownership after the cicd-improvement run: miwco is the primary owner of the growth, age and quarantine alarms and incidents, and the weekly owner session reviews them each week as backup coverage. Only owner and ownerLogin (the account each alarm issue is assigned to) change; no ceiling, estimate or measurement moves.

Ceilings that match measured reality, with a dated plan to bring them down (owner request 2026-11-11, run issue #1967). The complete report of 2026-11-11 (weekly-audit run 43014542120) measured offline 654.3 per landing, backend 219.9 per landing and 79.7 per day, graphics 36.3 per landing (18.6 net of ci04-catalog-gate). Raised: offline per landing 535 to 720, backend per landing 117 to 235 and per day 78 to 88, graphics per landing 10 to 20. Nothing else moves; no exception is added or renewed. The steps in reductionPlan bring each back to its version 2 line.
